Basil highlighted the early difficulties he faced regarding training facilities and upper body workouts, as well as the guidance provided by his coach and parents. Emphasizing his routine of training morning and evening with rest only on Sundays, Basil stated, "Disability does not matter," encouraging aspiring athletes to work hard in their chosen fields.
